abilities.name: Stone-crush roots
abilities.function: Use actual reusable stone and bark to crush roots for later eating, conserving nutrients and age.
abilities.costs: One actual stone and bark are reserved reusable implements; prepare 1–4 owned roots with two rounds per raw root, one energy per round. Defaults to a nearby eastward worksite; explicit x/y select another actual site. No silent relocation if blocked. New assess-surface/prepare-small operations require separate root-preparation-surface mastery; legacy prepare retains its whole-unit inputs and existing costs.
abilities.effects: Preserve mass, nutrients, toxicity and accumulated spoilage. Crushed food ages at 1.25 baseline. Partial cancellation retains its actual processing fraction and age. No cooking or preservation benefit is implied.

execution.progress: Exact processId, actual site, escrow, reusable tools, paid energy and remaining work. Continue resumes; changing actions or lost reach pauses. Cancel/death releases actual material once without effort refunds.

abilities.name: Root air drying
abilities.function: Assemble a reusable stone-and-bark tray, process actual roots and allow weather-dependent drying with reversible preservation while sufficiently dry.
abilities.costs: Build: two stone units and one bark, two rounds at one energy. Load: up to two original root units, two crushing rounds per raw root at one energy. Already crushed compatible food needs one transfer round, with its prior costs and composition preserved. Unload/dismantle: one round and one energy. Passive weather exchange costs no actor rounds.
abilities.effects: Food begins at its represented composition or the reviewed 50% root water assumption. Uncovered dry weather at 10–40 C removes at most 0.005 water mass per root per round to fraction 0.12; rain returns up to 0.01 per root, capped at original water. At fraction <=0.12 decay is 0.35 baseline, otherwise crushed food is 1.25 baseline. Exposure continues after unloading. No lost nutrients, reverse spoilage, sterilization or free materials.

execution.progress: Exact processId, actual site, escrow, reusable tools, paid energy and remaining work. Continue resumes; changing actions or lost reach pauses. Cancel/death releases actual material once without effort refunds.

abilities.name: Assess and peel actual branch bark
abilities.function: Assess actual materials and separate a finite branch outer layer using a personally inspected reusable stone or flint contact.
abilities.costs: Assess: one round and 0.2 energy. Peel: two active work-round equivalents and two energy per original branch unit, proportionally less for fractional or partly peeled inputs; one final partial simulation round pays only remaining effort. Reserve actual source and one reusable inspected hard stone/flint. No hard inventory capacity exists; actual load costs continue.
abilities.effects: Standing trunks without represented tissue remain ineligible. Unspecified intact branch partitions at most 10% of existing mass into outer bark. Exact-tenth bark units round down; sub-unit mass stays bark-fines. Peeled core cannot satisfy intact-branch recipes. Existing composition, nutrients, toxins, fuel and age persist. Cancellation/death releases actual partial materials once. Assessment alone has no reward; a new verified paid separation can use existing grounded understanding.

execution.progress: Exact personal processId, paid and remaining effort, reserved tool, actual separated mass and residual layer. Reissue peel with processId to resume. Other actions pause; cancel/death terminates without refund.

abilities.name: Open and inspect an actual food sample
abilities.function: Use a real hard tool to open a small owned hazelnut portion and retain its mechanical exposure and observed state without ingesting or certifying safety.
abilities.costs: Start requires sampleId and toolId: reserve 0.1 actual hazelnut unit and one reusable stone/flint of sufficient intrinsic hardness. Two active rounds at 0.5 energy each expose the same-mass sample. Inspect costs one round and 0.2 energy. Continue/cancel use the exact personal processId and no replacement inputs.
abilities.effects: Adjacent clear reachable ground and usable hard-tool contact are required each paid round. Existing age, composition, ownership and provenance persist. Cancellation/death leaves actual partial material and tool at the worksite. Previously paid partial opening remains in the sample. Nutrition, toxicity, anatomy and safety remain unknown; no edible yield, sterilization or preservation is inferred. Baseline aging remains because the applicability of crushed-food aging to merely opened hazelnut is unvalidated. Only a first completed paid opening can confirm mechanical access through the unchanged canonical understanding rule.

execution.progress: Actual processId, completed and remaining work, reserved sample/tool and paid energy. Other actions pause; continue resumes; cancellation and death retain actual partial progress without refunds.

abilities.name: Combine compatible material supplies
abilities.function: Combine actual compatible passive material stacks into one addressable supply with conserved component provenance.
abilities.costs: Combine: 2–16 distinct exact owned unlocked carried supplies, one active round and 0.5 energy. Status: one round, no energy; supply sourceIds or personal processId. Cancel names a still-active processId. Optional expectedVersions maps every exact source ID to the version returned by status; any change rejects.
abilities.effects: Same canonical unit, passive form and intrinsic profile required; histories and ages may differ and remain separate. Edible blends, indivisible equipment and active processing have no generic combination law in this version. Ground supplies must first be actually picked up; this engine has no unreserved privately owned ground disposition. No teleportation or added material. Exact stable slices preserve partial reservations, transfers and per-component spoilage. Aggregation awards no pleasure, practice or understanding.

execution.progress: One atomic paid handling round; started event shows one remaining work, completed shows zero. Status exposes real versions and lots. Cancel/death releases unsettled original records once.

abilities.name: Assess and use a fractional root-preparation surface
abilities.function: Assess the actual connected bark rectangle and hard tool on firm support, then prepare at most one root using that physically sufficient sheet.
abilities.costs: Separately learn this extension after root-preparation. assess-surface: barkId, toolId and optional site{x,y}, one round and 0.2 energy. prepare-small: assessed barkId, toolId, rootId, quantity in exact tenths from 0.1 to 1, and optional site. Reserve only that root portion, the whole selected sheet and one reusable stone. Two work equivalents and two energy per original root; a fractional final increment costs only remaining work. Continue/status/cancel name processId.
abilities.effects: One connected rectangle at least 0.16 by 0.16 m contains food on firm support; a single unfragmented extracted bark lot may use explicitly uncertain mass-conserving model geometry at density 500 and thickness 0.003, unless represented geometry exists. Separate combined lots and fines are not joined sheets. Actual stone hardness >=3, flexible intact sheet, clear reachable site and energy are required. Processing conserves nutrition, toxins, mass and age; crushed food ages at 1.25 baseline. Lost access pauses without work while food ages. Cancel/death releases actual partial food and implements once. No nutrition, preservation or safety benefit is inferred.

execution.progress: Actual processId, selected root quantity, sheet geometry basis, paid fractional work/energy, remaining work and pause reason. No second reservation while continuing.

abilities.effects: Read only your actual carried supplies, sorted by exact identity; show availability and represented form, never hidden composition or assumed suitability. Ground and other people are excluded. Each result is dated and complete for its requested page; the next read flags changes to listed holdings. It is a past read, not guaranteed current inventory. No material mutation, reward, mastery, ongoing process or world object. Full bounded result is preserved separately from the shortened default summary.

reviews.experienceReview: Explanation alone, registration and learning receive no feedback. A paid assessment that successfully establishes genuinely new, personally applicable information may use the existing grounded-understanding source through information-confirmed on root-preparation-surface, qualified=true, with the assessor as sole beneficiary: amount 0.8, cap 1, duration 8 rounds, refresh repetition and cooldown 12 rounds. Its existing maintained component gains 0.035 per qualifying event and decays 0.0015 per round without continued qualifying participation. Repeated known diagnostics do not qualify; no additional practice or alias source is created. Nutrition, health and physical comfort are unchanged.
reviews.visualReview: Bind the paid root-surface-assessed event to a dated checklist showing pass, fail and unknown separately, actual values versus thresholds, evidence references and explicit model assumptions. Display the existing sheet footprint and required rectangle at the assessed site using shared geometry, with support or collision failures marked only where actually resolved. Replay stores the assessment-time result and geometry references rather than substituting current conditions. Failed or unresolved checks must remain visible even when another check fails; presentation must not depict food processing, consumed materials or a suitable surface unless those effects actually occurred.
reviews.specification: Deliver root-preparation@3 as a backward-compatible diagnostic extension of root-preparation-surface, recording reuse of its existing assessment and geometry code separately from the new diagnostic behavior. Preserve existing preparation requirements and effects. Public assess-surface input remains {barkId,toolId,site?:{x,y}}; add optional assessmentId for reading an owned retained result, without recomputing historical conditions. Use shared exact-item identity, ownership, availability, interaction distance 0.65, world coordinates, collision and support queries. A fresh assessment costs one active round and 0.2 energy, with no material consumption or root requirement; retained-result reading costs one round and 0.2 energy. Evaluate every implemented prerequisite independently, including sheet continuity, usable dimensions/condition, tool eligibility and required inspection evidence, support, reach, clearance and availability. Return {assessmentId,tick,site,suitable,checks:[{code,status:pass|fail|unknown,observed,required,evidenceIds,basis}],failedChecks,unresolvedChecks}; suitable is true only when all required checks pass. Distinguish runtime material properties from personally observed or model-derived evidence. Explain an implemented hardness check using its actual threshold and resolved material value, without inventing a hardness measurement; if personal contact inspection is separately required, identify that requirement and its existing executable inspection route and cost. Do not silently introduce a new inspection prerequisite. Use represented sheet geometry and shared support/collision state, not terrain labels alone; absent required evidence stays unknown. Missing food must not invalidate surface assessment, although food remains required for preparation. Retain bounded dated results with source identities and geometry revisions; later preparation revalidates mutable conditions. Old suitable-only records migrate as legacy results with unavailable diagnostics explicitly unknown; never reconstruct past failures from present state. Execution is atomic at the paid round boundary: validate actor alive and sufficient energy, evaluate current state, debit once and emit root-surface-assessed. Before commitment, interruption or death cancels with no debit or result; there is no escrow, reserved material, persistent work or automatic continuation. Return actual remaining work of one round before commitment and zero after completion. Invalid identity or authorization errors emit failed without disclosing inaccessible state. Subscribe and render root-surface-assessed and failed; optionally emit information-confirmed only for a genuinely new, evidence-supported finding under the existing qualification rules. Add no physical objects, stock, mastery or changes to protected mental accounts. Implementation and review consume no simulation time.

reviews.reason: The implemented drying capability requires a two-stone, one-bark tray; surface assessment for crushing does not implement a smaller drying support or its persistent weather exposure. Develop a minimal ground-supported drying trial, reusing the existing food-processing and weather kernels rather than duplicating them. Your stone may suffice for ballast and manual crushing, subject to inspection; the missing owned bark remains a real prerequisite. Another participant's reported bark is not available without an actual transfer. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Assessment, building, learning and merely starting a trial award no wellbeing. A completed paid trial can plausibly provide the satisfaction of resolving a genuine uncertainty about this small support or its drying behavior. Emit information-confirmed for the performing actor only when dated before/after measurements establish a previously unresolved finding under recorded load, geometry and weather conditions; repeated known results do not qualify. Reuse grounded-understanding, not a new alias: transient amount 0.8, source cap 1, duration 8 rounds, refresh repetition and 12-round cooldown. Separately reuse its maintained contribution, gain 0.035 per qualifying event, bounded by the existing source saturation and global mental cap, with decay 0.0015 per round; waiting beside a tray does not maintain it. Apply the existing source-wide cooldown and deduplication across interfaces. There is no separate pleasure award for construction or mastery, and no health, comfort or nutrition benefit unless actual food and physical state changes establish one.
reviews.visualReview: Render the actual small bark sheet, individual ballast contacts and loaded sample at their shared-world positions, distinct from the larger existing tray. Show measured dimensions, model assumptions, dated assessment failures, reserved materials, paid progress, remaining work, moisture, accumulated age and weather pauses. Replay events must show construction only after paid completion, crushing only as performed, water loss or rewetting only from recorded exchanges, and partial materials on cancellation or death. Use neutral appearance and labels: neither a finished support nor a dry-looking sample implies safety, successful preservation or earned happiness.
reviews.specification: Implement root-small-drying@1, prerequisite personally mastered root-air-drying. Public operations: assess({site:{x,y},stoneIds,barkId,sampleId}), build({assessmentId}), load({supportId,sampleId}), inspect({supportId}), unload({supportId}), dismantle({supportId}), cancel({processId}). References are exact existing identities; coordinates use shared world metres, reach 0.65, dt=1, existing collision, weather, energy and food kernels. Assess costs one round and 0.2 energy, changes no material, and returns independently dated pass/fail/unknown evidence for ownership, availability, geometry, firm non-waterlogged ground, reach, clearance and load capacity; unknown never passes. Smallest design: a ground-supported connected bark sheet with a clear 0.16-by-0.16 m food rectangle and an exterior ballast margin of at least 0.02 m, held by 0.5 actual stone unit, carrying exactly 0.1 original root unit. Require an intact bark lot with sufficient real mass and geometry; where geometry is unrepresented, explicitly record the same uncertain mass-conserving bark model used by root-preparation-surface: density 500 kg/m3 and thickness 0.003 m. A square 0.2 bark unit can satisfy this model, but fragmented lots cannot become a connected sheet by aggregation. Inspect actual stone contact suitability for crushing and ballast placement; no need to claim elevated load-bearing capacity. No resources are supplied. Build reserves exact owned materials, takes two active rounds at 0.5 energy each, and creates a real positioned support with sheet and ballast geometry; its interaction footprint must remain clear and reachable, and its physical components participate in shared collision without turning the food rectangle into a solid obstacle. Load reserves 0.1 owned root unit, uses the support's suitable stone for crushing before replacing it as ballast, and charges the existing proportional crushing work: 0.2 work-round equivalent and 0.2 energy for wholly raw input, scheduled in an active round; already processed fractions reduce only remaining work. Require the food's represented volume to fit in the clear rectangle at no more than 0.003 m layer thickness; use an explicitly uncertain 1000 kg/m3 volume model only when volume is absent. Otherwise fail without consuming the sample. Preserve component provenance, nutrients, toxicity, original-root equivalent, moisture, age and prior processing; use the existing 50% root-water assumption only where that kernel permits it. Drying begins only after completed loading. Reuse root-air-drying's temperature, rain, moisture-floor, spoilage and rewetting laws, with a 0.5 exposure multiplier on evaporation for the blocked underside: at most 0.00025 water mass per round for this sample under qualifying dry weather. Evaporated water enters the environmental ledger; rain adds only real modelled environmental water, capped by original moisture. No nutrition or safety improvement is invented. Preservation applies only while the existing dryness threshold actually holds; wet ground, flooding, displaced ballast or lost clearance pauses evaporation and records the condition, while ageing and applicable rewetting continue. Persist support components, owner, assessment assumptions, food identity, environmental exchanges, actual completed work and remaining work. Revalidate material/site conditions before every paid increment. Interrupted work pauses without fresh charges for completed work; cancel or death terminates active work, retaining partial material, food and tools exactly once at the actual site under their existing ownership, with no cloning, deletion or automatic completion. Passive drying may continue only if the completed support remains physically valid; death cancels actor-bound work, not material weather physics. Unload transfers the same food only with actual reach and carrying capacity; dismantle requires an empty support, one active round and 0.5 energy, returning surviving components with their real wear. Maintenance requires actual paid repair or repositioning, not automatic regeneration. Declare and validate subscriptions for small-drying-assessed, small-drying-built, small-drying-loaded, small-drying-progress, small-drying-stopped, small-drying-unloaded and small-drying-dismantled; also reuse information-confirmed, process-inspected and food-rewetted where applicable. Events carry actor/process/support/component identities, costs, position, work delta, remaining work, moisture/age changes and stop reasons. Record code reuse separately from this new functional interface. Migration is additive: preserve all existing trays, contracts, records and satisfaction-source identities; register the new interface as an alternative trigger of grounded-understanding only for qualified information-confirmed events. No stock, mastery or simulation time is granted by implementation.
